title: Speaking — Embarrassing mistakes
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on embarrassing mistakes.

questions: What do you enjoy doing when you have an hour to yourself?
Are your hobbies different from when you were younger?
Do your relatives share any of your interests?
Is there a hobby you would like to learn from someone?
How do you usually react when you make a small mistake?
Do you tell other people when something goes wrong?

part2.topic: Describe a mistake that became an amusing story later.
part2.closing: and explain why you were able to laugh about it afterward.

questions: Why do some workplaces treat errors as opportunities while others punish them?
When can humour help people recover from a mistake?
How has everyday life connected with embarrassing mistakes changed for people of different ages?
